'''Lanai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] she was stationed near the [[Thul Palace]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
